Attachments: acme_sig_v2.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, sig format v2); NDA_signed.pdf (PDF)

Hi Lena —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps around the vendor security questionnaire so your procurement/security teams can move forward: 

- Redwood will complete the SIG/Consensus (we generally fill the SIG v2 spreadsheet) unless you prefer CAIQ or a custom form. I attached our usual SIG template (acme_sig_v2.xlsx) and a copy of the signed NDA you requested.
- For compliance context: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II and we support HIPAA-protected data under a BAA. I can share our SOC 2 auditor letter and an evidence portal link once we have an NDA in place.
- Clarifying items from the call that will help speed completion:
  1) Does AcmeHealth require in-scope data residency (US-only) or specific region controls?
  2) Are there specific encryption controls (e.g., customer-managed keys) required for this engagement?
  3) Which format do you prefer for completed answers (SIG spreadsheet, PDF export, or your custom vendor questionnaire)?
  4) Target timeline for completion and the procurement contact who will review answers?

Proposed next steps: I can (A) return a completed SIG spreadsheet by Friday 2027-04-16, and (B) schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through any redlines. If you prefer to send your vendor questionnaire instead, we can complete that — just let me know the format and any high-priority sections.

Thanks — looping Marissa on the thread for any additional security artifacts she can share.

Best,

From: Lena Patel <lena.patel@acmehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:21 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire Initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up & next steps)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. A few quick clarifying questions from our InfoSec and procurement teams before you complete the SIG: 

1) SOC 2: We need confirmation that this is SOC 2 Type II covering the last 12 months and that the scope includes change management and incident response. Can you confirm?
2) HIPAA/BAA: We will need a BAA in place for PHI. Is that standard for Redwood — can you send a template?
3) Encryption: Does Redwood support encryption at rest with customer-managed keys (BYOK) or only provider-managed keys? Also, what ciphers/TLS versions are used in transit?
4) Logging & Monitoring: Do you retain audit logs for at least 12 months and are logs accessible for forensic review?
5) Custom questionnaire: We also have a short 20-question vendor questionnaire (attached as acme_vendor_qs.pdf) that our procurement team prefers. Will you complete that instead of SIG, or do you prefer SIG + our questions?

Final items: procurement would like the initial answers within 5 business days if possible. Our procurement lead is Steve Morales (steve.morales@acmehealth.com).

If you prefer, we can hop on a quick call to go through a few of these items.

Best,
Lena Patel
Sr. Security Program Manager, AcmeHealth

Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire Initiation - AcmeHealth (clarifying questions)
Attachments: acme_sig_v2_completed_draft.xlsx (Excel, draft answers)

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the clear list — answering inline below and proposing next steps. Marissa is cc'd and will attach SOC 2 artifacts and our BAA template.

1) SOC 2: Confirmed — Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II covering the last 12 months and the report includes change management and incident response in scope. We will provide a secure report link for your review (see link below).

2) BAA: Yes — we can execute a BAA. Marissa, can you please attach the standard BAA template and confirm signing cadence?

3) Encryption: At-rest encryption is enabled by default with provider-managed keys; we also support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for enterprise plans — let me know if Acme requires BYOK and we'll route to our infra team. In transit we support TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 preferred) with modern ciphers (AES-GCM).

4) Logging & Monitoring: We retain audit logs for 13 months by default and can extend retention for Dedicated/Private deployments. Logs can be provided for forensic review under an NDA and data access agreement; we can also provide sample IDS/alerting screenshots.

5) Custom questionnaire: Happy to complete your 20-question packet. To streamline, we attached a draft completed SIG spreadsheet (acme_sig_v2_completed_draft.xlsx) covering the majority of standard questions and we can map any gaps to your custom doc. If procurement prefers only your PDF, send it and we'll prioritize that first.

Proposed timeline: we will deliver a finalized SIG/answers by end-of-day Friday 2027-04-16. If you need faster turnaround on specific items (SOC2, BAA, encryption) we can prioritize those within 48 hours.

Proposed next step: schedule a 30-minute call Thu 2027-04-15 10:00 AM PT to review any high-priority items and confirm procurement next steps. Does that work for you and Steve?

Links & artifacts:
- SOC 2 report (secure): https://redwood-inference.soc2reports.example/ACME-2027
- Draft SIG answers (attached): acme_sig_v2_completed_draft.xlsx
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/ACME-2027-EXP-43

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Marissa posts the SOC 2 evidence links and the BAA.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
